transcript.en: I've been reading your personal statement, Paul.
transcript.zh: 保罗，我最近在读你的一份个人陈述。

transcript.en: First, let's talk about your work experience in South America.
transcript.zh: 首先，让我们谈谈你在南美洲的工作经历。

transcript.en: What took you there?
transcript.zh: 你为什么想去那儿

transcript.en: Was it to gain more fluency in Spanish?
transcript.zh: 是为了讲好西班牙语吗

transcript.en: Well, as I'm combining Spanish with Latin American studies, my main idea was to find out more about the way people lived there.
transcript.zh: 我在做拉丁美洲的西班牙语研究的时候，我主要是想了解更多当地人的生活。

transcript.en: My spoken Spanish was already pretty good in fact.
transcript.zh: 其实我的西班牙语已经说得够好了

transcript.en: So you weren't too worried about language barriers?
transcript.zh: 所以你不用担心语言障碍

transcript.en: No.
transcript.zh: 不用

transcript.en: In fact, I ended up teaching English there, although that wasn't my original choice of work.
transcript.zh: 其实我最后是在当地教英文，虽然那并不是我一开始选择的工作，

transcript.en: I see.
transcript.zh: 我明白了

transcript.en: How did you find out about all this?
transcript.zh: 你是怎么发现这件事的

transcript.en: I found an agency that runs all kinds of voluntary projects in South America.
transcript.zh: 我找到一家在南美地区做各种志愿活动的机构

transcript.en: What kind of work?
transcript.zh: 都有什么样的工作

transcript.en: Well, there were several possibilities.
transcript.zh: 有很多可能性

transcript.en: You mean construction?
transcript.zh: 你是指建筑？

transcript.en: Engineering work?
transcript.zh: 工程工作？

transcript.en: Yes, getting involved in building projects was an option.
transcript.zh: 是的，参与大楼建设是一个选择。

transcript.en: Then there was tourism - taking tourists for walks around the volcanoes - which I actually chose to do, and then there was work with local farmers.
transcript.zh: 再者就是做导游，带着游客们在火山周边游览，这个其实我曾经做过，而后是和当地农民一起工作。

transcript.en: But you didn't continue with that project.
transcript.zh: 但是你没有继续把这个项目做下去

transcript.en: Why not?
transcript.zh: 为什么

transcript.en: Because I never really knew whether I'd be needed or not.
transcript.zh: 因为我从来不知道我是否真的有必要留在那儿

transcript.en: I'd thought it might be difficult physically, but I was certainly fit enough...no, I wanted to do something that had more of a proper structure to it, I suppose.
transcript.zh: 我本以为做这个会身体吃不消，但是我完全能胜任。不，不过我想做更有组织的事情

transcript.en: I get de-motivated otherwise.
transcript.zh: 否则我将失去动力。

transcript.en: What do you think you learned from your experience?
transcript.zh: 你从你的经历中学到了什么

transcript.en: It must have been a great opportunity to examine community life.
transcript.zh: 这里肯定有很多机会考察社区生活

transcript.en: Yes, but it was difficult at first to be accepted by the locals.
transcript.zh: 是的，但是起初很难被当地人接受。

transcript.en: It was a very remote village and some of them were reluctant to speak to me - although they were always interested in my clothes and how much I'd had to pay for them.
transcript.zh: 那是一个非常偏僻的村庄，他们中的一些人不愿意和我说话，尽管他们总是对我的衣服和衣服价钱感兴趣。

transcript.en: Well, that's understandable.
transcript.zh: 这个可以理解

transcript.en: Yes, but things soon improved.
transcript.zh: 是的，渐渐地情况有所改观

transcript.en: What struck me was that when people became more comfortable with me and less suspicious, we really connected with each other in a meaningful way.
transcript.zh: 最让我惊讶的是村民和我待在一起时感到融洽，也不多疑了，我们可以做真正有意义的沟通了。

transcript.en: You made good friends?
transcript.zh: 你交了好朋友吗

transcript.en: Yes, with two of the families in particular.
transcript.zh: 是的，特别是与其中的两家人

transcript.en: Good. What about management.
transcript.zh: 很好，管理怎么样？

transcript.en: Did you have a project manager?
transcript.zh: 你有项目经理吗

transcript.en: Yes and he gave me lots of advice and guidance.
transcript.zh: 是的，他给了我很多建议和指导。

transcript.en: And was he good at managing too?
transcript.zh: 他也擅长管理吗

transcript.en: That wasn't his strong point!
transcript.zh: 那不是他的强项。

transcript.en: I think he was often more interested in the academic side of things than filing reports.
transcript.zh: 我认为相比归档报告，他对学术方面的事情更感兴趣。

transcript.en: He was a bit of a dreamer.
transcript.zh: 他有一点不切实际

transcript.en: And did you have a contract?
transcript.zh: 你签合同了吗

transcript.en: I had to stay for a minimum of three months.
transcript.zh: 我得在那里至少待3个月

transcript.en: My parents were surprised when I asked to stay longer - six months in the end.
transcript.zh: 当我说我要待得久一点，最后成了6个月时，我父母感到很惊讶，

transcript.en: I was so happy there.
transcript.zh: 我在那里很开心

transcript.en: And did anything on the administration side of things surprise you?
transcript.zh: 有没有行政上面的事情很吸引你

transcript.en: What was the food and lodging like?
transcript.zh: 那里的食物和住宿怎么样

transcript.en: Simple...but there was plenty to eat and I only paid seven dollars a day for that which was amazing really.
transcript.zh: 很简单，但是有很多吃的，我每天只需花7美元，真的很便宜。

transcript.en: And they gave me all the equipment I needed...even a laptop.
transcript.zh: 另外他们给了我一切所需的设备，甚至还有一台笔记本电脑。

transcript.en: You didn't expect that then?
transcript.zh: 你并没有想到

transcript.en: No.
transcript.zh: 没有

transcript.en: Well, I'll look forward to hearing more.
transcript.zh: 我期待听到更多事情

transcript.en: But now let's look at these modules.
transcript.zh: 但是现在让我们看看这些课程

transcript.en: You'll need to start thinking about which ones you'll definitely want to study.
transcript.zh: 你得想想哪一个是你很想学的

transcript.en: The first one here is Gender Studies in Latin America.
transcript.zh: 首先是拉丁美洲的性别研究

transcript.en: Mmm...
It looks at how gender analysis is reconfiguring civil society in Latin America.
transcript.zh: 这个着眼于性别分析如何重建拉丁美洲的文明社会

transcript.en: Women are increasingly occupying positions in government and in other elected leadership positions in Latin America.
transcript.zh: 女人在拉丁美洲越来越多的占据政府部门和其他选举领导人的职位。

transcript.en: I think you'd find it interesting.
transcript.zh: 我认为你会觉得这很有趣

transcript.en: If it was to do with people in the villages rather than those in the public sphere, I would.
transcript.zh: 如果是关于普通村民，而不是公众人物的话，我愿意。

transcript.en: Okay.
transcript.zh: 好的

transcript.en: What about Second Language Acquisition?
transcript.zh: 那么第二语言的学习怎么样

transcript.en: Do you think I'd find that useful?
transcript.zh: 你觉得我会认为那很有用

transcript.en: Well, you've had some practical experience in the field, I think it would be.
transcript.zh: 你在这方面有一些经验，所以我是这么想的。

transcript.en: I hadn't thought about that.
transcript.zh: 我还没想过

transcript.en: I'll put that down as a definite, then.
transcript.zh: 那我会把这点记下

transcript.en: Okay.
transcript.zh: 好的

transcript.en: What about Indigenous Women's Lives.
transcript.zh: 原住民妇女的生活怎么样

transcript.en: That sounds appropriate.
transcript.zh: 这个听起来很合适

transcript.en: I thought so too, but I looked at last year's exam questions and that changed my mind.
transcript.zh: 我也这么想过，但是我看了去年考试的问题后改变了想法。

transcript.en: Don't judge the value of the course on that.
transcript.zh: 别根据那个评判课程的价值

transcript.en: Maybe, talk to some other students first and we can talk about it again later.
transcript.zh: 也许你可以先跟其他同学讨论，然后我们再讨论一下，

transcript.en: Okay.
transcript.zh: 好的

transcript.en: Yes.
transcript.zh: 好的

transcript.en: And lastly, will you sign up for Portuguese lessons?
transcript.zh: 最后一点，你想上葡萄牙语课吗

transcript.en: My Spanish is good, so would I find that module easy?
transcript.zh: 我的西班牙语很好，是不是意味着我学葡萄牙会轻松。

transcript.en: Not necessarily.
transcript.zh: 不一定

transcript.en: Some people find that Spanish interferes with learning Portuguese...getting the accent right too.
transcript.zh: 很多人发现西班牙语会干扰葡萄牙语的学习，也会干扰正确的发音，

transcript.en: It's quite different in a lot of ways.
transcript.zh: 在很多方面都不同

transcript.en: Well, I'd much sooner do something else, then.
transcript.zh: 我宁愿做点别的事情

transcript.en: Alright.
transcript.zh: 好的

transcript.en: Now, what we need to do is...
transcript.zh: 现在我们要做的是……
